labels.label:
WHY: Trigger the Binance data ingestion process at a fixed one-second interval.
-
WHAT: Creates a FlowFile on a timer that initiates the HTTP request to the Binance API.

WHY: Provide the list of Coinbase trading pairs that need to be queried for market data.
-
WHAT: Creates a FlowFile containing a list of Coinbase product identifiers (BTC-USD, ETH-USD...).

WHY: Ensure each Coinbase trading pair is fetched independently and processed in isolation.
-
WHAT: Splits the list of product identifiers so that each FlowFile contains exactly one symbol.

WHY: Standardize metadata across exchanges and align Coinbase data with Binance data.
-
WHAT: Adds the following attributes: symbol = symbol

WHY: Retrieve up-to-date bid and ask prices for all trading pairs from Binance in the most efficient way.
-
WHAT: Calls the Binance /api/v3/ticker/bookTicker endpoint and receives an array containing bid/ask data for all symbols.

WHY: Ensure each Kafka message is fully self-contained and includes all required metadata.
-
WHAT: Injects the following attributes into the JSON payload: event_time

WHY: Capture the ingestion timestamp as close as possible to the moment the market data is received.
-
WHAT: Adds metadata as FlowFile attributes, including:
event_time = current ingestion timestamp

WHY: Fetch the latest market data for a specific Coinbase trading pair.
-
WHAT: Calls the Coinbase /products/{symbol}/ticker endpoint and retrieves bid, ask, and price data for that product.

WHY: Ensure that each trading pair is processed independently and downstream logic operates on one symbol at a time.
-
WHAT: Splits the filtered records so that each FlowFile contains exactly one symbol’s market data.

WHY: Reduce the volume of incoming data to only the symbols required for analysis and arbitrage.
-
WHAT: Filters the Binance response to keep only the selected trading pairs:
BTCUSDT / ETHUSDT /  BNBUSDT / SOLUSDT / XRPUSDT

WHY: Make the enriched Binance market data available for real-time processing and analytics.
- 
WHAT: Publishes one Kafka message per symbol per second to the Binance Kafka topic.

WHY: Ensure Coinbase market data messages are fully self-describing when published to Kafka.
-
WHAT: Merges metadata attributes into the JSON payload, including: symbol

WHY: Make enriched Coinbase market data available for downstream streaming analytics.
-
WHAT: Publishes one Kafka message per symbol per second to the Coinbase Kafka topic.

WHY: Preserve the trading pair identifier throughout the pipeline for enrichment and routing.
-
WHAT: Extracts the symbol from the FlowFile content and stores it as the symbol attribute.
